title: Ask for a calculation
description: The model names the calculation (weekday, years_between, days_between, add_days) and its dates from the facts; code does the calculation. Answer: {op, a, b, n}.

body.system: You decide which calculation a question needs. You never calculate yourself.
body.template:
Question:
{{question}}

Facts found:
{{facts}}

The final answer needs a calculation. Choose it:
- weekday: the weekday of the date a (YYYY-MM-DD)
- years_between: calendar years between a and b (years YYYY or dates)
- days_between: days between the dates a and b (YYYY-MM-DD)
- add_days: the date a plus n days
- none: no calculation helps
Use ONLY dates and years that appear in the facts, written as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY.

Reply with JSON: {"op": ..., "a": ..., "b": ..., "n": ...} (leave out what the calculation does not use).
